children: (the “Company”), parent company of Centennial Bank (“Centennial”), announced today that its Board of Directors increased the number of shares authorized for repurchase under the Company’s stock repurchase program and declared its regular quarterly cash dividend.

On October 16, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company increased the number of shares of the Company’s common stock authorized for repurchase under its stock repurchase program to 20,000,000 shares. The program was originally approved by the Board in January 2008 and was most recently amended in January 2025. As of October 16, 2026, approximately 13,450,123 shares remained available under the existing authorization; therefore, the Board’s action increased the number of shares available for repurchase by 6,549,877. Since the program’s inception, the Company has repurchased 33,057,384 shares of HOMB common stock for an aggregate purchase price of $701.8 million.

In addition, the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share, payable December 2, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 11, 2026. The dividend is consistent with the quarterly dividend paid in the third quarter of 2026 and represents the Company’s 82nd consecutive quarterly cash dividend since its initial public offering.

“Our strong earnings and capital position provide us the opportunity to continue to repurchase Home BancShares stock. We view share repurchases as a highly effective way to increase shareholder value. As shares are repurchased and retired, our shareholders benefit by increasing their personal ownership position in our company. Another benefit to our shareholders is a quarterly dividend. Our Board of Directors increased the dividend by $0.02, or 9.5% a share in the third quarter this year. We will review the amount again this time next year,” said John Allison, Chairman.

Home BancShares, Inc. is a bank holding company, headquartered in Conway, Arkansas. Its wholly-owned subsidiary, Centennial Bank, provides a broad range of commercial and retail banking plus related financial services to businesses, real estate developers, investors, individuals and municipalities. Centennial Bank has branch locations in Arkansas, Florida, Texas, Tennessee, South Alabama and New York City. The Company’s common stock is traded through the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “HOMB.” The Company was founded in 1998. Visit www.homebancshares.com or www.my100bank.com for more information.
